conformanceTest.smoke: Run every row on the reference base M4 tier and attribute CPU, memory, wakeups, GPU, decoder, network, storage churn, and frame pacing.
For every row, verify the direct setting or action and deterministic chat use the same typed command, or present the same read-only or unsupported explanation.

evidenceCatalog.summary: Stable settings surface used to bind behavior shared with the stable launch baseline.
Screen saver registration, default selection, activation timing, and repair controls.
Wallpaper lifecycle, visibility, power, thermal, camera, continuity, and cache controls.
Display targeting, synchronization, aspect, spanning, mirroring, and margin controls.
Location, Night Shift, appearance, manual solar rules, windows, and preview behavior.
Cache size, location, replacement, network trust, and backup exclusion controls.
Formats, fades, audio, battery, orientation, language, logging, and reset behavior.
Reduced motion, keyboard shortcuts, solid surfaces, and video color inversion.
Sparkle-backed update cadence, automatic installation, beta channel, and manual checks.
Personal MOV and MP4 copy import, collision handling, metadata, and unsupported files.
First-run detection and user choice for legacy cache migration, fresh defaults, and optional reclamation.
Download completion lifecycle and VoiceOver announcements for completed video downloads.
Video metadata, selection, download, favorites, hidden state, and direct actions.
Named playlist persistence, ordered entries, cycle modes, and import or export behavior.
Source browsing, filtering, selection, search, activity, and current browser state.
HLS, YouTube, and RTSP feed lifecycle, duration, credentials, reload, and persistence.
External helper discovery and explicit setup needed for YouTube and RTSP sources.
Expansion discovery, link installation, progress, source enablement, and removal.
Per-display overlay layout, separate modes, login hiding, startup version, and rotation.
Visual overlay editor, palette, seven-zone layout, live preview, and style inspection.
Global pause, previous, next, screen saver, and fullscreen shortcut actions.
Playback coordination, source transitions, skip behavior, and synchronized state.
Wallpaper continuity handoff and shared state across desktop and lock transitions.
Immutable official user-facing feature descriptions reviewed with the frozen Aerial baselines.
Immutable official compatibility, format, cache, live feed, and troubleshooting guidance.
Immutable official opt-in expansion catalog and independent content-license descriptions.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports installation in system or user Applications with location-aware guidance.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support a simple signed drag-install and report the exact supported installation scope.

test.smoke: Install in each documented location and verify launch, permissions, and removal.

rows.aerialBehavior: Detects whether the screen saver extension is registered and offers enablement.
rows.ambientBehavior: Register only supported components and surface registration health with a repair action.

test.smoke: Fresh install registers once; repair restores a deliberately disabled extension.

rows.aerialBehavior: Sets Aerial as default and offers 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 60 minutes or never.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide supported default selection and system-consistent activation choices without hidden polling.

test.smoke: Select each supported activation value and verify the system reflects it exactly.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses Sparkle for update checks, automatic installation, cadence, and manual checks.
rows.ambientBehavior: Ship authenticated updates with exact-source provenance, explicit cadence, rollback, and recovery.

test.smoke: Verify signature, provenance, update, rollback, and rejection of a tampered package.

rows.aerialBehavior: Lets users opt into beta updates separately from the normal release track.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose explicit stable and preview channels with capability and support-lifecycle labels.

test.smoke: Switch channels and prove only correctly signed eligible versions are offered.

rows.aerialBehavior: Offers debug cleanup when duplicate screen saver registrations are detected.
rows.ambientBehavior: Detect duplicate components, explain the conflict, and offer a reversible scoped repair.

test.smoke: Create a safe duplicate fixture, repair it, and verify unrelated components remain untouched.

rows.aerialBehavior: Documents component registration and cache locations but does not unify full recovery.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide verified uninstall, restore, last-known-good recovery, and user-data retention choices.

test.smoke: Uninstall, reinstall, recover preferences, and prove originals and unrelated data are preserved.

rows.aerialBehavior: Provides a rerunnable wizard that applies sensible defaults and guides wallpaper mode, overlays, and setup choices.
rows.ambientBehavior: Guide users through Static first, then optional Hybrid, then Advanced Live with capability and cost previews; allow rerun without data loss.

test.smoke: Complete, skip, resume, rerun, and reset onboarding on a clean account using keyboard and VoiceOver.

rows.aerialBehavior: Detects Aerial 3 data and offers migration, fresh defaults, or fresh start with optional legacy-data reclamation.
rows.ambientBehavior: Detect prior Project Ambient versions, preview exact data actions, copy and verify before cleanup, and retain rollback.

test.smoke: Migrate, start fresh, reclaim, interrupt, retry, and roll back versioned legacy fixtures.

rows.aerialBehavior: Basic screen saver playback can continue after the companion application quits.
rows.ambientBehavior: Keep static and cached saver operation independent of a continuously running settings UI.

test.smoke: Quit the control app, enter the saver twice, and measure no unnecessary control process.

rows.aerialBehavior: Starts the screen saver from UI and a configurable global keyboard shortcut.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer an accessible manual start command through UI, typed command bus, and shortcut.

test.smoke: Invoke all three entry paths and verify one idempotent saver transition.

rows.aerialBehavior: Coordinates wallpaper and saver playback so lock transitions can retain visual continuity.
rows.ambientBehavior: Deterministically preserve the same source and crop or documented fallback across lock transitions.

test.smoke: Lock twice on mixed-orientation displays and compare source, crop, and transition trace.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses the active filter or playlist to choose screen saver videos.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use the same versioned selection policy across saver and wallpaper modes with visible reasons.

test.smoke: Apply each source policy and prove every saver selection is eligible and explained.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows a screen saver overlay layout distinct from wallpaper and fullscreen layouts.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support an accessible saver overlay profile with preview and login privacy controls.

test.smoke: Apply distinct saver and wallpaper layouts and verify lock-screen sensitive fields are hidden.

rows.aerialBehavior: Provides troubleshooting and registration repair for saver failures.
rows.ambientBehavior: Restore last-known-good static output and present actionable diagnostics instead of a blank screen.

test.smoke: Inject source and extension failures and verify nonblank restoration plus a repair reason.

rows.aerialBehavior: Shows the current display-sleep timing and links to macOS settings when sleep would preempt the saver.
rows.ambientBehavior: Detect incompatible idle and display-sleep timing, explain it, and deep-link without silently changing system policy.

test.smoke: Configure sleep before and after saver activation and verify warning and supported handoff.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can display a still frame derived from the current video as the wallpaper.
rows.ambientBehavior: Make first-class original-resolution still images the default zero-idle product direction.

test.smoke: Apply an 8K still to two displays and verify no continuous renderer or decoder remains.

rows.aerialBehavior: Plays supported video sources as the desktop wallpaper through the native extension path.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use supported OS integration with exact capability reporting and deterministic static fallback.

test.smoke: Apply live wallpaper, restart the session, and verify capability state and static fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Exposes wallpaper start, pause, resume, and stop controls from the companion.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose idempotent controls through direct UI and the same typed local command bus used by chat.

test.smoke: Repeat each command, verify idempotency, preview, result verification, and undo.

rows.aerialBehavior: Pauses wallpaper when hidden past a configurable 30 to 90 percent coverage threshold.
rows.ambientBehavior: Apply measured occlusion policy with per-display state, low wakeups, and visible rationale.

test.smoke: Sweep coverage thresholds on two displays and verify pause decisions and wakeup budget.

rows.aerialBehavior: Live coverage inspection can identify covering applications and let the user Ignore selected apps.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer a local allowlist of applications excluded from coverage after explicit preview, with reset and visible effect.

test.smoke: Ignore and restore ordinary, borderless, renamed, and removed test applications and verify coverage decisions.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can auto-advance the selected scene on a chosen interval even while wallpaper is paused.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer explicit schedule and lock-only policies with next-action preview and no hidden polling.

test.smoke: Simulate scheduled and lock events and prove exactly one eligible change per policy event.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can launch at login and optionally restart wallpaper playback when the app launches.
rows.ambientBehavior: Restore last-known-good state at login without requiring the settings or chat window to remain open.

test.smoke: Reboot and log in with UI closed; verify one restoration and no redundant services.

rows.aerialBehavior: Synchronizes selected video state with desktop transitions and the lock screen.
rows.ambientBehavior: Maintain deterministic source identity across Spaces, Mission Control, lock, and topology changes.

test.smoke: Move across Spaces, lock, and reconnect displays while comparing deterministic source IDs.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can grant access, cap the macOS wallpaper cache near 2 GB, and reclaim system aerial files.
rows.ambientBehavior: Explain OS-owned storage, request scoped access, and offer reversible bounded cleanup with estimates.

test.smoke: Fill a test cache, deny and grant access, clean only scoped files, and verify rollback guidance.

rows.aerialBehavior: Warns about HDR wallpaper behavior and offers SDR and HDR format choices.
rows.ambientBehavior: Default to SDR, truthfully report HDR support, and select only display and decoder compatible assets.

test.smoke: Exercise SDR and supported HDR displays and verify selection, warning, and SDR fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Launches and exits fullscreen playback from the companion or global shortcut.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide an accessible fullscreen preview using the shared playback engine and safe exit path.

test.smoke: Enter and exit from UI and shortcut on each display without trapping keyboard focus.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses the selected source, filters, playback controls, and transitions in fullscreen.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use one typed policy and source engine across fullscreen, wallpaper, and saver surfaces.

test.smoke: Compare source IDs, policy decisions, and controls across all three surfaces.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports a fullscreen overlay layout distinct from wallpaper and screen saver layouts.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer previewable, accessible surface-specific overlay profiles with shared reusable components.

test.smoke: Switch surfaces and verify only the selected overlay profile is rendered and announced.

rows.aerialBehavior: Browses Apple aerial sources with scene metadata, location, points of interest, and formats.
rows.ambientBehavior: Integrate only through independently licensed or user-authorized sources with rights evidence.

test.smoke: Browse a rights-valid fixture catalog and reject assets lacking permitted-use evidence.

rows.capability: Scene metadata and points of interest
rows.aerialBehavior: Displays location, scene, time-of-day, point-of-interest, and localized metadata.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preserve provenance and localized metadata while allowing corrections without altering originals.

test.smoke: Import localized metadata fixtures, edit catalog metadata, and compare original hashes.

rows.aerialBehavior: Shows available encodes and downloads the configured compatible video format.
rows.ambientBehavior: Rank resolution, codec, FPS, HDR, display, decoder, memory, and measured energy before selection.

test.smoke: Score incompatible and compatible encodes and verify the lowest-cost quality target wins.

rows.aerialBehavior: Downloads cacheable Apple videos for local playback and marks download state.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use verified local cache, bounded concurrency, hashes, progress, offline playback, and safe eviction.

test.smoke: Download, verify digest, disconnect network, play, corrupt, and recover a fixture asset.

rows.aerialBehavior: Lets users favorite desired videos and hide unwanted videos from normal rotation.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer reversible favorite and hide actions through direct UI and typed command bus.

test.smoke: Favorite and hide fixtures, rotate repeatedly, then undo and verify deterministic eligibility.

rows.aerialBehavior: Copies supported MOV and MP4 files into a shared My Videos folder.
rows.ambientBehavior: Import supported images and videos by copy or explicit reference while preserving originals and provenance.

test.smoke: Import mixed media and verify source hashes, copy hashes, provenance, and no source mutation.

rows.aerialBehavior: Does not accept personal still images as native My Videos assets.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support JPEG, HEIF, PNG, TIFF, and RAW-derived stills without video conversion or continuous rendering.

test.smoke: Import orientation and color-profile fixtures and render deterministic display-ready derivatives.

rows.aerialBehavior: Copy import preserves the source and creates unique names on destination collisions.
rows.ambientBehavior: Never move or alter originals; record source, derivative, collision, and rights provenance explicitly.

test.smoke: Import colliding files and compare source metadata and hashes before and after removal.

rows.aerialBehavior: My Videos scans one flat folder and skips nested directories.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer scoped recursive import with preview, ignore rules, duplicate detection, and cancellation.

test.smoke: Import a nested fixture tree with aliases, duplicates, unsupported files, and cancellation.

rows.aerialBehavior: Avoids filename collision but does not provide a content-hash duplicate workflow.
rows.ambientBehavior: Detect exact and declared derivative duplicates before copy while preserving user choice.

test.smoke: Import renamed identical and near-duplicate fixtures and verify deterministic dedupe decisions.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows personal video naming, description, location, point-of-interest, and time metadata.
rows.ambientBehavior: Store reversible catalog metadata separately from immutable originals with provenance history.

test.smoke: Edit every metadata field, export and restore it, and compare original asset hashes.

rows.aerialBehavior: Marks unsupported extensions and reports files that cannot be used.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preflight codec, container, dimensions, color, duration, availability, and rights with actionable remedies.

test.smoke: Run malformed and unsupported fixtures and verify stable codes, remedies, and no partial catalog entry.

rows.aerialBehavior: Provides grid, multi-selection, inspector, thumbnails, and direct video actions.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide accessible batch metadata, rights, playlist, download, remove, and preview actions.

test.smoke: Select mixed assets, apply a batch edit, undo it, and verify keyboard and screen-reader paths.

rows.aerialBehavior: Reveals imported copies in Finder and can move selected My Videos copies to Trash.
rows.ambientBehavior: Reveal catalog assets and remove only managed copies after preview, preserving sources, references, and rollback metadata.

test.smoke: Reveal and remove managed copies and references and prove all original hashes remain unchanged.

rows.capability: Playlist create rename delete and order
rows.aerialBehavior: Creates named playlists with ordered entries and supports rename and deletion.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide transactional accessible playlist editing with undo and deterministic ordering.

test.smoke: Create, reorder, rename, delete, undo, restart, and compare the persisted ordered manifest.

rows.aerialBehavior: Combines Apple videos, expansions, live feeds, and personal media in playlists.
rows.ambientBehavior: Combine rights-valid local, pack, cached, and live assets with explicit fallback policy.

test.smoke: Build a mixed fixture playlist and verify eligible playback offline and with feed failure.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports loop and shuffle cycle modes for user playlists.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support loop, seeded shuffle, no-repeat shuffle, deterministic order, and explainable next choice.

test.smoke: Replay fixed seeds and verify ordering, no-repeat behavior, persistence, and explanation.

rows.aerialBehavior: Lets users play an item directly and select the active playlist for rotation.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide preview then apply for direct selections and expose current and next source visibly.

test.smoke: Direct-play an entry, resume policy rotation, and verify Now, Next, Why, and undo.

rows.aerialBehavior: Exports and imports playlists so they can be shared between Macs.
rows.ambientBehavior: Round-trip versioned offline bundles with provenance, rights, hashes, migrations, and conflict preview.

test.smoke: Export, remove test catalog, restore offline, and compare assets, order, rights, and provenance.

rows.aerialBehavior: Display modes can share a synchronized stream or choose content independently.
rows.ambientBehavior: Assign one source, deterministic continuity crops, or independent policies per stable display identity.

test.smoke: Apply shared and independent assignments, reconnect displays, and compare stable mappings.

rows.capability: Location favorites time scene source filters
rows.aerialBehavior: Filters eligible videos by location, favorites, time, scene, and source.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide composable typed filters with visible eligible counts and an explanation for exclusions.

test.smoke: Evaluate every filter dimension and combination against a fixed eligibility fixture.

rows.aerialBehavior: Treats live feeds and installed expansions as selectable source filters.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose source health, network and rights requirements before live or pack sources become eligible.

test.smoke: Toggle pack and feed sources and verify health, rights, network, and fallback eligibility.

rows.aerialBehavior: Searches across content sources and presents source-grouped results.
rows.ambientBehavior: Search locally indexed metadata without uploading filenames, paths, prompts, or media contents.

test.smoke: Search fixture metadata offline and inspect network and diagnostic logs for prohibited fields.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can favor videos matching display orientation and uses a globally selected format.
rows.ambientBehavior: Rank orientation, crop, resolution, codec, FPS, refresh rate, decoder, memory, and energy per display.

test.smoke: Score mixed-orientation assets for horizontal and vertical high-refresh displays under pressure.

rows.aerialBehavior: Selection falls through or skips when the current set cannot yield a playable item.
rows.ambientBehavior: Explain an empty set and deterministically widen only user-approved fallback tiers without going blank.

test.smoke: Force empty and unplayable sets and verify explanation, fallback order, and last-known-good output.

rows.aerialBehavior: Browses downloaded and not-downloaded items as dedicated library views.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose verified offline availability and distinguish cached, missing, queued, corrupt, and live-only states.

test.smoke: Move fixtures through every availability state and verify filtering and counts.

rows.aerialBehavior: Browses the same video results in thumbnail grid and compact list presentations.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide accessible grid and list views over one result model with preserved selection, search, and focus.

test.smoke: Switch view modes during search and multi-selection and verify content, focus, and actions.

rows.capability: Tags energy tier and rights filters
rows.aerialBehavior: Does not expose a unified tag, measured-energy, and permitted-use filter across all source types.
rows.ambientBehavior: Filter on user tags, measured resource tier, and actor-scoped rights state with exclusion explanations.

test.smoke: Independently and jointly filter tag, energy-tier, and rights fixtures and verify every exclusion reason.

rows.aerialBehavior: Accepts HLS live-stream URLs and plays them for a configured duration.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support health-checked HLS with explicit network consent, bounded resources, and static fallback.

test.smoke: Play a local HLS fixture, interrupt it, and verify bounded retry and deterministic fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses ffmpeg tooling to transmux RTSP feeds for playback.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer an isolated optional adapter with explicit helper provenance, resource limits, and uninstall.

test.smoke: Play authenticated local RTSP and RTSPS fixtures and inspect helper sandbox, memory, and teardown.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses yt-dlp to resolve a YouTube live page to a playable stream.
rows.ambientBehavior: Make the optional resolver explicit, versioned, removable, terms-reviewed, and unable to bypass rights policy.

test.smoke: Resolve an approved fixture, reject stale terms evidence, and verify helper removal and fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports URL credentials and masks them in the user interface.
rows.ambientBehavior: Store secrets in OS secure storage, redact URLs and logs, and never place credentials in manifests.

test.smoke: Use credential fixtures and inspect UI, storage, diagnostics, export, crash, and command history.

rows.aerialBehavior: Previews feeds, sets 10 to 1800 second playback duration, and reloads resolver or transmuxer state.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preview with resource attribution, validate duration, and provide idempotent reconnect with bounded backoff.

test.smoke: Preview, change boundary durations, reload repeatedly, and verify one bounded resolver process.

rows.aerialBehavior: Skips a failed live feed and moves to the next item at rotation time.
rows.ambientBehavior: Continuously avoid blank output using cached video then static fallback, with Now, Next, and Why.

test.smoke: Inject timeout, malformed media, DNS, and decoder failures and verify ordered nonblank fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Streams live sources in real time and does not cache them as ordinary downloadable videos.
rows.ambientBehavior: Show active network and decoder cost, stop both when ineligible, and retain only explicit safe metadata.

test.smoke: Pause, occlude, lock, and switch away while measuring network, decoder, process, and memory teardown.

rows.aerialBehavior: Personal MP4 files are supported, while live-source UX focuses on HLS, YouTube, and RTSP.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support approved progressive MP4 URLs with range requests, health checks, rights validation, and fallback.

test.smoke: Exercise ranged, non-ranged, slow, malformed, expired, and rights-invalid MP4 sources.

rows.aerialBehavior: Browses expansion packs and installs none automatically.
rows.ambientBehavior: Browse rights-validated creator packs with explicit preview, size, license, and opt-in installation.

test.smoke: Open a fresh account and prove no pack installs or downloads before explicit consent.

rows.aerialBehavior: Accepts a compatible expansion link and guides installation or already-installed state.
rows.ambientBehavior: Validate signed versioned manifests, rights, hashes, size, origin, and compatibility before install.

test.smoke: Install valid, tampered, duplicate, incompatible, and rights-incomplete pack fixtures.

rows.aerialBehavior: Expansion packs carry licenses independent from Aerial software.
rows.ambientBehavior: Require actor-scoped rights manifests and render attribution, term, takedown, and allowed-use state.

test.smoke: Reject contradictory or expired rights and show attribution for every accepted pack asset.

rows.capability: Pack install progress update and removal
rows.aerialBehavior: Shows installation activity and lets users enable, update, or remove expansions.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide resumable bounded downloads, digest checks, migrations, rollback, and scoped removal.

test.smoke: Interrupt install and update, resume, roll back, remove, and compare unrelated catalog hashes.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses community-maintained expansion manifests for curated third-party content.
rows.ambientBehavior: Publish a signed creator manifest schema, offline validator, author guide, and reproducible package tool.

test.smoke: Build, sign, validate, import, export, and tamper with a complete creator-pack fixture.

rows.capability: All main secondary and selected targeting
rows.aerialBehavior: Targets all, main, secondary, or individually selected displays.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose stable display identities and preview the exact target set before apply.

test.smoke: Apply to every target mode and verify untouched displays retain prior state.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows each display to choose and play a different source independently.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support independent sources with per-display resource accounting and stable restoration.

test.smoke: Run different sources, restart and reconnect, then verify stable per-display restoration.

rows.aerialBehavior: Cloned or shared modes can show the same source across displays.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer same-image, synchronized-video, and deterministic continuity-crop modes explicitly.

test.smoke: Compare source IDs and timecodes across horizontal and vertical displays after lock.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports spanning one scene across displays and mirroring a selected display.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support topology-valid span and mirror with seam preview, resolution checks, and safe fallback.

test.smoke: Span and mirror mixed-scale displays, rotate one, disconnect it, and verify fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Mirrored viewing provides a reflected display treatment for supported layouts.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer explicit horizontal and vertical flip only where useful, previewed per display and reversible.

test.smoke: Golden-test horizontal, vertical, combined, and reset transforms across text and panorama fixtures.

rows.aerialBehavior: Provides fill and fit modes for video aspect handling.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preview fill, fit, continuity crop, safe-area, and letterbox consequences per display.

test.smoke: Golden-test each aspect mode across landscape, portrait, ultrawide, and mixed-scale fixtures.

rows.aerialBehavior: Configures horizontal and vertical margins globally or per display.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer visual safe areas and per-display crop offsets with reset and keyboard precision.

test.smoke: Set global and per-display offsets, restart, reset, and compare rendered safe areas.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows display-specific selection and overlay layout behavior.
rows.ambientBehavior: Bind typed source policies and overlay profiles to stable display identities with preview.

test.smoke: Assign distinct policies and layouts, swap main display, and verify stable mappings.

rows.aerialBehavior: Responds to screen configuration and shared wallpaper state changes.
rows.ambientBehavior: Debounce topology events, restore by stable identity, and never blank or churn renderers.

test.smoke: Hot-plug, rotate, sleep, wake, and reorder displays while tracing apply count and recovery.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses location services to calculate current sunrise and sunset periods.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use opt-in coarse location locally, expose precision, and retain an offline manual fallback.

test.smoke: Simulate permission states and locations and verify local solar calculation and redaction.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows manually entered sunrise and sunset values when location is not used.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer city, timezone, or manual solar schedule without requiring precise location or network.

test.smoke: Run manual and city fixtures across DST and timezone boundaries without network access.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can derive day or night from Night Shift or macOS Light and Dark appearance.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use supported system signals as explainable optional inputs with deterministic manual fallback.

test.smoke: Toggle supported appearance signals and verify one deterministic day or night transition.

rows.aerialBehavior: Defines one to four hour sunrise and sunset windows for time-based scene filtering.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support previewable gradual windows, exact event boundaries, and no continuous unnecessary decode.

test.smoke: Advance a synthetic clock through all window boundaries and inspect exact policy traces.

rows.aerialBehavior: Previews how time rules classify the current day and night periods.
rows.ambientBehavior: Show a 24-hour policy timeline with current, next, trigger, source, and fallback.

test.smoke: Compare the visual timeline against evaluator outputs for a full synthetic year.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows scene metadata and personal videos to override time-of-day eligibility.
rows.ambientBehavior: Store explicit reversible per-asset eligibility with provenance and conflict explanation.

test.smoke: Apply conflicting source and asset time rules and verify the documented precedence.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can keep playing, always disable on battery, or disable only at low battery.
rows.ambientBehavior: Apply explainable battery policies only where a battery exists and expose manual temporary override.

test.smoke: Simulate AC, battery, low battery, and no-battery hardware and verify decisions.

rows.aerialBehavior: Optionally pauses wallpaper playback when macOS Low Power Mode is active.
rows.ambientBehavior: Treat Low Power Mode as a first-class policy signal with a visible reason and static fallback.

test.smoke: Toggle a synthetic Low Power signal and verify decoder teardown and static continuity.

rows.aerialBehavior: Pauses at serious or critical thermal pressure when enabled.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use supported thermal signals and measured resource budgets to degrade live to cached to static.

test.smoke: Inject nominal, fair, serious, and critical pressure and verify deterministic fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can pause wallpaper when camera activity is detected and reads only activity state.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use privacy-preserving on-device camera-use state only, never image or application identity.

test.smoke: Simulate camera activity and inspect all logs and payloads for prohibited detail.

rows.aerialBehavior: Tracks screen coverage and can coordinate pause behavior for shared display playback.
rows.ambientBehavior: Avoid duplicate decoders while calculating per-display eligibility and shared-source pause deterministically.

test.smoke: Occlude one or both displays in shared mode and count decoders, wakeups, and transitions.

rows.aerialBehavior: Offers explicit formats and a high-frame-rate slow-wallpaper source option.
rows.ambientBehavior: Auto-select by source FPS, display refresh, decode capability, memory, CPU, GPU, network, and frame pacing.

test.smoke: Benchmark a quality ladder on base M4 and high-refresh displays and verify budget compliance.

rows.aerialBehavior: Still wallpaper reduces playback cost but remains derived from video-oriented behavior.
rows.ambientBehavior: Apply native static files then exit rendering, decoding, networking, and scheduling paths while idle.

test.smoke: Measure base M4 steady state for CPU, RAM, wakeups, decoder, network, and helper processes.

rows.aerialBehavior: Surfaces some playback and pause controls without a unified causal decision trace.
rows.ambientBehavior: Show Now, Next, Why, resource attribution, trigger, fallback, and reversible override for every decision.

test.smoke: Run the synthetic event suite and compare every decision to its explanation and fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Documents performance optimizations but does not define Project Ambient's reference-hardware gate.
rows.ambientBehavior: Pass enforceable CPU, memory, wakeup, decoder, network, frame-pacing, and leak budgets for 48 to 72 hours.

test.smoke: Run the accepted base-M4 matrix for 48 to 72 hours and verify every resource budget.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports disabled, 0.5, 1, and 2 second fades.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support cut and timed fades with frame-pacing budgets and no duplicate decoder leaks.

test.smoke: Measure duration, frame pacing, decoder overlap, and memory for every fade setting.

rows.aerialBehavior: Honors system Reduce Motion by disabling fades and reducing motion effects.
rows.ambientBehavior: Honor accessibility settings across transitions, pans, overlays, onboarding, and preview.

test.smoke: Enable Reduce Motion and verify all animated surfaces choose the documented alternative.

rows.aerialBehavior: Coordinates wallpaper and screen saver time state for smoother handoff.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preserve source identity and last displayed frame through every supported surface transition.

test.smoke: Capture frame and source traces across wallpaper, saver, lock, unlock, and fullscreen.

rows.aerialBehavior: Skips failed content and proceeds to another playable source.
rows.ambientBehavior: Retain last-known-good output until the next source is verified ready, then atomically apply.

rows.ambientBehavior: Add dip-to-black and bounded zoom-fade transitions with preview and non-motion alternatives.

test.smoke: Golden-test dip and zoom timing, reduced-motion substitution, frame pacing, and decoder overlap.

rows.aerialBehavior: Provides a visual editor with seven screen zones and stacked overlay components.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide an accessible preview editor with keyboard placement, safe areas, and structured layout data.

test.smoke: Place components in every zone using pointer, keyboard, and screen reader, then restart.

rows.aerialBehavior: Supports display-specific layouts and distinct wallpaper, saver, and fullscreen arrangements.
rows.ambientBehavior: Store stable reusable profiles per display and surface with preview and deterministic fallback.

test.smoke: Assign profiles across displays and surfaces, reconnect, and verify exact stable restoration.

rows.capability: Clock date location weather battery components
rows.aerialBehavior: Offers clock, date, location, weather, and battery overlay components.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide local-first components with explicit data source, freshness, permission, and resource cost.

test.smoke: Render every component offline and online and inspect permissions, freshness, and redaction.

rows.capability: Spacer message countdown timer and music components
rows.aerialBehavior: Offers spacer, message, countdown, timer, and current-music overlay components.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide accessible local components with deterministic state, pause behavior, and no hidden uploads.

test.smoke: Exercise each component through restart, pause, lock, no-network, and accessibility states.

rows.capability: Typography color opacity and shadow styling
rows.aerialBehavior: Configures font, size, weight, opacity, color, margins, and shadow appearance.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer accessible tokens, contrast warnings, preview, reset, and theme-safe styling.

test.smoke: Snapshot style extremes, verify contrast warnings, reset, and dynamic accessibility scaling.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can hide overlays while a login password prompt is visible.
rows.ambientBehavior: Default sensitive components off on authentication surfaces and explain the privacy boundary.

test.smoke: Lock from every supported profile and inspect the authentication surface for private content.

rows.aerialBehavior: Moves overlay layout never, every 10, 30, or 60 seconds to reduce persistent positioning.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer low-wakeup OLED-safe movement with display-specific amplitude and visible cost estimate.

test.smoke: Run movement intervals on OLED fixtures and measure position coverage, wakeups, and frame pacing.

rows.aerialBehavior: Message overlays can display custom text or content read from a file.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support literal text and security-scoped local files with preview, encoding checks, and redaction.

test.smoke: Load valid, missing, oversized, changed, and malformed local message fixtures safely.

rows.aerialBehavior: Message overlays can execute a configured shell command and display its output.
rows.ambientBehavior: Do not execute arbitrary shell; offer typed allowlisted local actions or literal and file sources.

test.smoke: Attempt shell metacharacters and arbitrary executables and verify fail-closed typed alternatives.

exception.rationale: Arbitrary shell execution from a persistent wallpaper surface creates unnecessary code-execution and data-exfiltration risk.
exception.userFacingAlternative: Use literal text, a security-scoped local file, or audited typed actions with preview and undo.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can briefly show the application version when the screen saver starts.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer an optional build and support-state badge using exact release provenance and accessible text.

test.smoke: Start the saver with the badge on and off and compare displayed and packaged build identity.

rows.aerialBehavior: Shows cache size and lets users download, remove, or re-download cached content.
rows.ambientBehavior: Show verified size, health, origin, rights, last use, and safe item or bulk actions.

test.smoke: Download, remove, restore, corrupt, verify, and evict fixtures while comparing catalog state.

rows.aerialBehavior: Selects a custom cache location and can migrate or start fresh while keeping old files.
rows.ambientBehavior: Validate capacity and permissions, perform resumable copy with hashes, and retain rollback.

test.smoke: Migrate to local and removable test volumes, interrupt, resume, disconnect, and roll back.

rows.aerialBehavior: Offers unlimited cache or selectable limits from 5 through 150 GB.
rows.ambientBehavior: Offer explicit byte budgets, projected quality tradeoffs, safe eviction, and storage-pressure fallback.

test.smoke: Cross each budget boundary and verify deterministic eviction without deleting originals.

rows.aerialBehavior: Refreshes cached choices daily, weekly, monthly, or never when automatic download is enabled.
rows.ambientBehavior: Schedule only eligible lock, idle, power, network, and storage windows with preview and pause.

test.smoke: Simulate cadence and eligibility signals and prove zero background fetch while disallowed.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can restrict automatic downloads to a trusted Wi-Fi SSID using location permission.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use an opt-in local network identity without logging or exporting SSIDs and always offer manual mode.

test.smoke: Simulate trusted, untrusted, unknown, and denied states and inspect redacted diagnostics.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can exclude downloaded cache files from Time Machine backups.
rows.ambientBehavior: Exclude reproducible cache only, never originals or unique user metadata, and expose current state.

test.smoke: Verify backup attributes apply only to reproducible cache and survive migration or reset.

rows.aerialBehavior: Cached sources play locally while live sources remain unavailable without network.
rows.ambientBehavior: Report offline readiness per playlist and fall back from live to cached to static deterministically.

test.smoke: Disconnect at every playback stage and verify offline readiness, fallback, and no retry storm.

rows.aerialBehavior: Operates without conventional analytics or telemetry collection.
rows.ambientBehavior: Keep diagnostics opt-in and local-first with explicit redaction, preview, export, and deletion.

test.smoke: Run a fresh install through all modes and assert no analytics endpoint or hidden payload.

rows.aerialBehavior: Requests location for solar scheduling and trusted Wi-Fi identification.
rows.ambientBehavior: Separate permissions, use minimum precision locally, and provide manual or city fallback.

test.smoke: Deny, allow, revoke, and reset each permission and inspect logs and stored precision.

rows.aerialBehavior: Keeps personal media local but diagnostic logs may describe operational file events.
rows.ambientBehavior: Never collect media contents, filenames, paths, prompts, precise location, or credentials in diagnostics.

test.smoke: Seed canary secrets in every prohibited field and scan logs, exports, crashes, and requests.

rows.aerialBehavior: Masks embedded feed credentials in UI while retaining them for playback.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use secure storage, structured redaction, scoped access, revocation, and secret-free exports.

test.smoke: Place canary credentials in each supported feed form and scan every output surface.

rows.aerialBehavior: Separates expansion content licenses from the MIT application license.
rows.ambientBehavior: Require versioned actor-scoped provenance and rights before redistribution or managed use.

test.smoke: Validate public, private, creator, enterprise, and live-source rights boundaries end to end.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses direct settings and controls rather than an integrated conversational command layer.
rows.ambientBehavior: Add offline deterministic chat over the same typed commands, with preview, policy, verification, undo, and no privileged bypass.

test.smoke: Compare direct and chat commands offline and prove identical policy, result, undo, and resource attribution.

rows.aerialBehavior: Does not include an in-app model-backed conversational settings layer.
rows.ambientBehavior: Allow an optional user-configured self-hosted provider that can only propose typed commands and never bypass preview, policy, verification, or undo.

test.smoke: Use a hostile local model fixture and prove it cannot invoke untyped, unpreviewed, or privileged actions.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses Apple sources, weather, live feeds, expansion links, and update services through feature-specific paths.
rows.ambientBehavior: List every possible and recently contacted domain by integration, purpose, data class, and last activity.

test.smoke: Exercise every integration and compare captured destinations with the declared domain inventory.

rows.aerialBehavior: Requires opt-in pack installation and user-entered live feeds, with helper setup where needed.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preview provider, data, rights, resource, credential, retention, and revocation effects before enabling each integration.

test.smoke: Deny, accept, revoke, and reinstall every integration while checking data and helper teardown.

rows.aerialBehavior: Stores local settings and offers reset but lacks one complete user-readable export and selective deletion workflow.
rows.ambientBehavior: Export versioned redacted settings and delete selected local state with preview, backup, verification, and media preservation.

test.smoke: Export, inspect, delete each scope, restore, and prove credentials and media paths remain excluded.

rows.aerialBehavior: Provides a Show Log action for troubleshooting.
rows.ambientBehavior: Provide structured locally redacted diagnostics with preview, consented export, retention, and deletion.

test.smoke: Generate every event class and scan preview and export for redaction and stable codes.

rows.aerialBehavior: Shows current playback and available control state but lacks a unified rule explanation.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose current output, next candidate, trigger, reason, fallback, resource cost, and override.

test.smoke: Compare user-facing explanations with evaluator traces across the synthetic event suite.

rows.aerialBehavior: Reports screen saver registration, feed tooling, downloads, and playback issues in separate surfaces.
rows.ambientBehavior: Unify capability, component, source, feed, cache, and last-known-good health with remedies.

test.smoke: Inject every modeled health failure and verify stable state, remedy, and fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Shows active expansion installation and video download progress.
rows.ambientBehavior: Show every background job, resource estimate, owner, cancellation, eligibility, and completion result.

test.smoke: Start, pause, cancel, fail, and resume each background job while checking resource state.

rows.aerialBehavior: Offers reset settings and targeted troubleshooting controls.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preview scoped reset, back up reversible state, preserve media, and verify restoration or rollback.

test.smoke: Reset each scope, verify originals remain, then restore the previous working configuration.

rows.aerialBehavior: Direct controls apply settings without a conversational verification transcript.
rows.ambientBehavior: Parse chat to typed intent, preview, authorize, apply, verify actual state, report result, and offer undo.

test.smoke: Run direct and conversational command fixtures including ambiguity, failure, retry, and undo.

rows.aerialBehavior: Honors increased contrast and can replace translucent popovers with a solid background.
rows.ambientBehavior: Honor system contrast and transparency settings across direct settings, onboarding, status, and chat.

test.smoke: Enable contrast and reduce-transparency settings and inspect every primary surface and focus state.

rows.aerialBehavior: Announces new video changes and completed downloads to VoiceOver users.
rows.ambientBehavior: Announce user-relevant source and job changes without flooding, secrets, filenames, paths, or duplicate events.

test.smoke: Trigger playback and download state changes and verify timely, deduplicated, redacted VoiceOver announcements.

rows.aerialBehavior: Offers 1080p H.264, 1080p HEVC, 1080p HDR, 4K HEVC, 4K HDR, and 4K SDR 240 fps.
rows.ambientBehavior: Expose compatible quality targets while automatically selecting the lowest-cost path meeting display needs.

test.smoke: Decode each fixture on the supported hardware matrix and verify truthful capability and fallback.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses 4K SDR 240 fps assets at selectable slow rates such as one eighth through normal speed.
rows.ambientBehavior: Select slow high-FPS playback only when hardware decoding and measured frame pacing meet the M4 budget.

test.smoke: Benchmark each speed against display refresh, dropped frames, memory, CPU, GPU, and decoder.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can mute video audio and normally enables audio only for suitable normal-speed playback.
rows.ambientBehavior: Default all wallpaper and saver media muted, with explicit per-session app-audio preview controls.

rows.ambientBehavior: Control only Project Ambient audio and direct users to macOS Sound or Focus for system policy.

rows.ambientBehavior: Provide conflict-checked accessible shortcuts mapped to idempotent typed commands and visible results.

rows.aerialBehavior: Can favor videos whose orientation matches the target display.
rows.ambientBehavior: Score orientation and continuity crop per display and explain why an asset was selected.

test.smoke: Rotate displays and compare scoring, crops, source continuity, and resource budgets.

rows.aerialBehavior: Allows automatic or explicit language selection for localized metadata.
rows.ambientBehavior: Use system language by default with explicit metadata-language override and complete fallback chain.

test.smoke: Switch supported and missing locales and verify deterministic metadata fallback and accessibility.

rows.aerialBehavior: Offers a setting that inverts video colors for accessibility or preference.
rows.ambientBehavior: Support system-consistent visual accommodations with preview, labels, and measured rendering cost.

test.smoke: Apply inversion to SDR and supported HDR fixtures and verify appearance, labels, and resource cost.

rows.aerialBehavior: Switches the global format with cache replacement and allows a compatible per-video override or reset.
rows.ambientBehavior: Preview storage and quality impact, prepare the replacement, verify it, then evict only the superseded cache copy.

test.smoke: Switch global and per-item formats, interrupt replacement, reset, and verify safe cache retention.

rows.aerialBehavior: Uses system video playback paths and recommends compatible H.264 or HEVC formats for efficient decoding.
rows.ambientBehavior: Select only hardware-decodable profiles by default and expose decoder path, fallback, and measured cost.

test.smoke: Verify decoder selection for every codec profile on base M4 and quarantine software-only regressions.

rows.ambientBehavior: Quarantine repeatedly failing items, preserve last-known-good output, and explain skip, retry, and fallback.
